text_block_list.text:
One day, after an outing. Having been 
asked to chaperone, I went to an amusement 
park with Chrono Genesis and the others.
choice_data_list: Umm, let's see, the park map is...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—...E-Everyone, um... Thank you all for 
your help today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Deepening your bond with your Trainer 
outside of racing? My, what wonderful 
love~♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna give it 100 miles of 
energy!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Alright, first up is that roller coaster!
choice_data_list: ...Huh?! A thrill ride right off the bat!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they take a photo the moment 
you drop. —You and Chrono should 
definitely try it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Are we almost at the top? If I remember 
correctly, this coaster's total length is 
2,000 meters, so—
choice_data_list:
Ah, it's the same distance as the Shuka 
Sho and stuff

Ah, it's the same distance as the Shuka 
Sho and stuff, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, got it! So right now, around the third 
corner—ah.
(KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... That was quite a steep drop. 
That was truly..."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, that slope had an elevation change 
of about 3.1 meters...

Yeah, that was easily a 3.1-meter 
elevation difference...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, fufuâ¡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey! We screamed our hearts out, so... 
while we catch our breath, let's go play 
that balloon popping game!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I agree! Ah, but since we're always 
competing against each other... Today 
it'll be Chrono-chan VS Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... it's all right! I'm sure you'll 
win next time...!
choice_data_list: Kuh... I'm a late-surging closer type!

Kuh... Because I'm a late-surging closer 
type!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. In that case, I will take the 
lead and run straight through to the 
finish...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! I-I did it again...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Phew, we played quite a bit, didn't we? 
Time for a break, time for a break.
choice_data_list: I'll go place the order, then.
I'll go place the order, then!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
......Uuu. I'm sorry, everyone. Even 
though you're all helping me out, I just 
can't take my mind off racing at all...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You really don't need to worry about it 
at all♪ Or rather, to begin with—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I think Chrono-chan and the others are 
already great friends, races aside!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-B-But! All I ever do is tie everything 
back to racing...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—From what I've heard, at least. You said 
so too, Trainer... right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It's probably the same as back at 
the zoo. Because you're so kind, 
Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then let's just go ask 
directly! —Traaaainer!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: Sorry I'm late... What's wrong?
Sorry I'm late... Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, why is that? Why are you mixing 
racing terms into your talk?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"A 3.1-meter elevation change," or 
"betweener/chaser type," and all sorts of 
other things!
choice_data_list: ...Huh, I said something like that!?
...Huh, I said something like that!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. So it was subconscious, then. ...I 
wonder if Chrono-chan's habit rubbed off 
on you?
choice_data_list:
I was just enjoying myself normally 
without even realizing it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...! ...It's the same... as me.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (In other words, does that mean—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. The two of you are such—good 
friends, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"—Oh, I know! To commemorate hanging out 
together, why don't we buy matching 
souvenirs?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on now. Chrono-chan, you and 
Trainer-san should too, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh... what should we do? They all... 
seem like wonderful souvenirs, though.
choice_data_list:
Tortoise and the Hare Animated Ballpoint 
Pen
Sweets in a stylish tin.

Take a commemorative photo instead of 
wearing matching outfits

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...That ballpoint pen is great for 
reminiscing about the zoo too...!
choice_data_list:
At this rate, though, the rabbit's never 
gonna finish first.

At this rate, though, the rabbit's never 
going to finish first.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-True... No, wait, if I tilt it just 
right, I might be able to slot it in--
choice_data_list:
Wait, ah! I went and brought racing into 
it again...

Wait, ah! I went and brought racing into 
it again...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah! M-Me too...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Hehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was such a lovely tin. What 
should we put in it once we finish the 
sweets?
choice_data_list: Like newspaper clippings or something?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! That sounds lovely! And then maybe add 
some small glassware...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! It looks like it'll become my 
treasure box...♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you really sure this is all you 
wanted?
choice_data_list:
I don't really take photos outside of 
races, you know.

I don't really take many photos outside of 
races, you know.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ! You have a point...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for this keepsake. ...I'll 
display it on my desk in the dorm.
